title: Questions 158-159 refer to the following advertisement.
passage_1:
Get the Drift V9!

If you are looking for a new cordless vacuum, consider the Drift V9 by Halcyon Works. The winner of the Home Appliance category at the annual Northfield Design Conference, it delivers the most thorough clean available. It has a number of advanced features, including:

  • Twin cyclone filters that trap fine dust without blocking the airflow
  • Rapid charging to ensure the machine is always ready for use
  • A sealed dust cup to allow for both carpet and hard-floor cleaning

To mark the first anniversary of the Drift V9’s launch, Halcyon Works is offering it at 20 percent off until March 9. Just visit www.halcyonworks.com and type “B720K” in the voucher box when you place your order. Don’t miss out on this remarkable machine!
